business_problem: Metronome needed a streaming foundation for usage-based billing that could handle huge event volumes, power real-time pricing and invoicing, and avoid consuming early engineering capacity on broker operations.
solution_summary: Metronome built its billing platform on Confluent Cloud from day one so the company could deliver real-time usage-based pricing without first inventing a streaming infrastructure layer. End-user activity produces usage events that flow through the managed platform, where they feed invoicing, threshold checks, notifications, and other customer-facing billing behaviors at very high scale. Schema Registry keeps formats consistent across teams and services, while pre-built connectors move data in and out of surrounding systems without custom integration work. Running the event-driven engine on AWS gives Metronome elastic scale as usage grows, which lets the company process billions of events per day and tens of thousands of invoices per second while keeping almost all engineering effort focused on product features instead of maintenance. The architecture turns near-real-time financial state into a core part of the SaaS product experience.
